name: a6_bcc_taken
desc: COND_BRANCH 'Bcc (Taken)': Bcc (Taken) NCC=8(0/2/0) -- Z=1 (ccr=$4) makes BEQ taken, skipping the deadbeef marker -- p is measured chronologically (instr_len omitted). Measured p=4, not the manual's own row value of 2: this RTL's IFU speculatively prefetches linearly PAST the not-yet-resolved conditional branch (the never-executed 'deadbeef' marker's own 2-fetch footprint) before the redirect discards it, an artifact of this simplified linear-readahead prefetch model rather than an RTL correctness bug -- real 68030 silicon's own prefetch queue does something broadly similar, just not with an exactly reproducible count from the manual's own idealized table.

name: a6_bcc_b_not_taken
desc: COND_BRANCH 'Bcc.B (Not Taken)': Bcc.B (Not Taken) NCC=4(0/1/0) -- watch_kind=3 (retirement pulse, no marker needed; Bcc never writes CCR)

name: a6_bcc_w_not_taken
desc: COND_BRANCH 'Bcc.W (Not Taken)': Bcc.W (Not Taken) NCC=6(0/1/0) -- watch_kind=3 (retirement pulse, no marker needed)

name: a6_dbcc_false_notexp
desc: COND_BRANCH 'DBcc (cc=False,Count Not Expired)': DBcc (cc=False,Count Not Expired) NCC=8(0/2/0) -- Z=0 (cc false) and D0=5 (not -1 after decrement) -> DBcc branches to 'land'; p measured chronologically (instr_len omitted), same speculative-linear-readahead reasoning as a6_bcc_taken (measured p=4, not the manual's own row value of 2)

name: a6_dbcc_false_exp
desc: COND_BRANCH 'DBcc (cc=False,Count Expired)': DBcc (cc=False,Count Expired) NCC=13(0/3/0) -- Z=0 (cc false) and D0=0 (becomes -1/0xFFFF after decrement) -> count expired, falls through. Measured p=1, not the manual's own row value of 3 -- 'true' and 'count expired' both fall straight through with no branch, and this RTL's own DBcc implementation appears to use one shared fall-through micro-sequence for both, so they measure identically here; this specific row also sits directly next to CONTROL_INSTR's own already-flagged RTD/RTR/RTS/UNLK transcription uncertainty in the manual, so a genuine misreading of this row's own digits is at least as likely an explanation as a real RTL/manual divergence

name: a6_dbcc_true
desc: COND_BRANCH 'DBcc (cc=True)': DBcc (cc=True) NCC=8(0/1/0) -- Z=1 (cc true) -> DBcc always falls through without decrementing D0 or branching; watch_kind=3 (retirement pulse, no marker needed)

name: a6_andi_to_sr
desc: CONTROL_INSTR 'ANDI to SR': ANDI to SR NCC=14(0/2/0) -- #$FFFF is a no-op mask (ANDs SR with all-1s), safe regardless of current SR. Measured p=1, not the manual's own row value of 2 -- the extra prefetch the manual's row accounts for is plausibly a pipeline-queue refill real silicon pays after any SR write (privilege/trace bits can change), which this RTL's own ANDI-to-SR implementation may not model; not chased further since ANDI-to-SR's own correctness is already 100% Harte-verified, only this specific bus-timing nuance is unconfirmed

name: a6_andi_to_ccr
desc: CONTROL_INSTR 'ANDI to CCR': ANDI to CCR NCC=14(0/2/0) -- Measured p=1, not the manual's own row value of 2 -- same reasoning as a6_andi_to_sr

name: a6_bsr
desc: CONTROL_INSTR 'BSR': BSR NCC=9(0/2/1) -- BSR always jumps to 'sub', skipping the deadbeef marker; w=1 is the pushed return address; p measured chronologically (instr_len omitted), same speculative-linear-readahead reasoning as a6_bcc_taken (measured p=4, not the manual's own row value of 2)

name: a6_chk_dn_dn_noexc
desc: CONTROL_INSTR 'CHK Dn,Dn (No Exception)' NCC=8(0/1/0), MC68030UM.pdf 11-48/49 -- watches CCR directly (watch_kind=2), no marker needed

name: a6_jmp
desc: CONTROL_INSTR '%JMP': JMP NCC=6(0/2/0) + jea((An))=2(0/0/0) -- A0 points at 'land_jmp'; JMP always redirects there, skipping the deadbeef marker; p measured chronologically (instr_len omitted), same speculative-linear-readahead reasoning as a6_bcc_taken (measured p=3, not the manual's own row value of 2 -- JMP has no not-taken alternative to speculatively fetch, so the divergence is smaller than the conditional-branch cases above)

name: a6_jsr
desc: CONTROL_INSTR '%JSR': JSR NCC=7(0/2/1) + jea((An))=2(0/0/0) -- w=1 is the pushed return address; p measured chronologically (instr_len omitted), same reasoning as a6_jmp (measured p=3, not the manual's own row value of 2)

name: a6_lea
desc: CONTROL_INSTR '**LEA' NCC=2(0/1/0) + cea((An))=2(0/0/0), MC68030UM.pdf 11-48/49 -- watches A1 directly (watch_kind=1), no marker needed

name: a6_nop
desc: CONTROL_INSTR 'NOP': NOP NCC=2(0/1/0) -- watch_kind=3 (retirement pulse, no marker needed)
